WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_rate) / NULLIF(AVG(rental_duration), 0) AS per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day
  FROM per_rating
), above_average AS (
  SELECT p.per_day, o.avg_per_day
  FROM per_rating p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.per_day > o.avg_per_day
)
SELECT AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day_of_above_average_ratings,
       AVG(per_day - avg_per_day) AS avg_excess_over_rating_average
FROM above_average
